tests.name: json_pointer_self_append_basic
tests.intent: Verify that appending a json_pointer to itself using operator/= correctly duplicates its reference tokens.

tests.name: json_pointer_self_append_empty
tests.intent: Verify that appending an empty json_pointer to itself behaves properly.

tests.name: json_pointer_self_append_root
tests.intent: Verify that self-appending a root slash json_pointer duplicates it safely.

tests.name: json_pointer_normal_append
tests.intent: Verify that appending a different non-aliased json_pointer works as expected.

tests.name: patch_inplace_self
tests.intent: Verify that calling patch_inplace on a JSON object passing itself as the patch applies correctly without memory corruption.

tests.name: patch_inplace_normal
tests.intent: Verify that patch_inplace works normally with a separate patch document.

tests.name: patch_inplace_nested_patch
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace when the patch is stored inside a field of the target json value itself.

tests.name: patch_inplace_empty_patch
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace with an empty patch array.

tests.name: json_pointer_chained_self_append
tests.intent: Verify multiple chained self-appends on a json_pointer execute correctly.

tests.name: patch_inplace_multiple_ops
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace handles multiple patch operations correctly on self-patching.

tests.name: json_pointer_constructor_copy
tests.intent: Verify that constructing a json_pointer from another works and can then be self-appended.

tests.name: patch_inplace_deeply_nested_target
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace when the json is a deeply nested structure applied to itself.

tests.name: patch_inplace_remove_op
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace correctly executes a remove operation when self-patching.

tests.name: patch_inplace_replace_op
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace executes replace operations when self-patching.

tests.name: patch_inplace_copy_op
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace handles copy operation successfully.

tests.name: patch_inplace_move_op
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace handles move operation successfully.

tests.name: patch_inplace_test_op
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace handles test operation successfully during self-patching.

tests.name: patch_inplace_invalid_op
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace reports errors properly on invalid patch operations.

tests.name: json_pointer_append_empty_token
tests.intent: Verify that self-appending a pointer with empty tokens works cleanly.

tests.name: patch_inplace_scalar_target
tests.intent: Verify that attempting to patch a scalar value with itself via patch_inplace is handled robustly.
